jobs.description:
Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator, Social Welfare (5256C) #89427 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Located within the world's finest public university and one of the most diverse regions in the nation, the UC Berkeley School of Social Welfare strives to transform the systems that perpetuate poverty and social disadvantage. UC Berkeley Social Welfare develops effective leaders and scholars committed to solving complex social problems; produces, disseminates, and utilizes research to improve social-service delivery and policy through critical thinking and evidence-based knowledge; and prepares the next generation of culturally-competent social workers, researchers, and teachers dedicated to serving the most vulnerable members of our society.
  
  
The Practicum Education Program serves over 200 MSW students and has regular interface with over 150 agencies at any given time. MSW students engage in practicums across a range of public settings, including, but not limited to, public schools, hospitals, nonprofit agencies, and mental health clinics. These practicums require student, faculty, and staff awareness of and adherence to university policies and regulations, agency policies and regulations, and social work professional regulations.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator works under the direction of the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience and collaboratively with the Dean's Office to manage program resources and conduct analytical studies of moderate scope and complexity to address policy and procedural issues. This position maintains secure systems for collecting student health clearances, student placement data, and other programmatic data, while coordinating administration of the Pupil Personnel Services Credential (PPSC) in Social Work and workforce programs.
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator supports practicum education by managing business partnerships with internship sites, coordinating the online interface for student internship search and matching, and managing learning contracts and student evaluations. This role handles sensitive onboarding data, including Protected Health Information (PHI) and background checks. Additionally, the position manages university-sponsored training and events and ensures data management and quality assurance in accordance with program policy.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Data and Systems Maintenance
  
  
Applies professional concepts to perform maintenance and analysis of data and systems pertaining to moderately complex projects, policies, and/or processes and functions.
  
Supports practicum education operations by maintaining accurate, confidential, secure, and timely data within multiple data management systems. With guidance from the Associate Dean for Curriculum and the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience, ensures consistency and quality assurance in accordance with the national accrediting body, the Council on Social Work Education, when engaging with and maintaining policies, projects, and issues that support program operations.
  
Provides regular technical support and training for database issues encountered by students, agency partners, and/or school representatives. Resolves procedural and technical issues in the context of department policies and procedures with a customer-service mindset.
  
Ensures proper database permissions and access for practicum instructors, faculty, students, advisors, and administrators, and that security roles and data storage align with UC data protection requirements.
  
Proactively identifies, proposes, and executes approved business process improvement projects, taking into account business practice and technical considerations.
  
Helps establish standards, guidelines, and best practices for database deliverables and program processes.
  
Ensures that operations and digital content comply with local and federal policies.
  
  
Analytical Reporting
  
  
Gathers and assembles analytical and factual data on assigned problems and issues to prepare reports and/or analyses summarizing information on the assigned issues and commenting on other significance for internal department constituents.
  
Prepares student placement, agency contact, student competency, and other reports as requested. In collaboration with the team, identifies trends, forecasts needs, and supports further analysis.
  
Performs analytical studies on a variety of policies, research initiatives, programs, and issues.
  
Provides recommendations and guidelines involving program initi

jobs.description:
Description:

Now is the time to join PDS Health. You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Overview:

The role of the Operations Manager Trainee (OMT) is to gain an understanding of the skills and company knowledge to independently run a financially viable PDS supported dental office. The OMT is responsible for engaging in and owning their professional development through completing the OM Development Program while being supported by their direct supervisor. This will be done in a variety of ways: through structured curriculum completion, on the job practical application and development meetings. The OMT role is hired with the expectations that each individual will be able to independently manage a dental office in 4-6 months, following timely completion of the OM Development Program.

**Responsibilities**

* Modeling company culture, values, standards and best operational practices based on the We Believe Behavioral Framework; actively learning how to create an environment that promotes PDS culture and values daily
* Assessment, hiring and retention of right fit team members through comprehensive training, supervision, counseling and coaching
* Assess, investigate, and resolve staff and patient issues by analyzing the facts and circumstances to develop timely, effective, logical yet creative solutions
* Execution of the PDS Operational Model with consistency to meet identified office imperatives in partnership with the Owner Dentist
* Driving year over year revenue and profit growth
* Management of expenses to achieve monthly goals and budget
* Show proficiency and adherence to cash management and accounting protocols
* How to be the catalyst in team development of the Perfect Patient Experience
* How to deliver effective leadership, coaching and mentoring with team members in an effort to identify and implement opportunities for improvement

* Gains proficiency and understands the tools and resources available with regards to People related functions, such as assessment, hiring, retention, performance evaluation, separation processes and compensation guidance and execution

* Report weekly to Regional Manager detailing accomplishments, areas for improvement, clear performance goals, and effectiveness of systems

* Develop and implement an office success plan; including development of staff, and office protocols to provide for efficient operations during manager absences
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by direct supervisor that will result in improved team member development outcomes

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Five or more years of related work experience in operational management
* Operations Manager Trainee must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance. Driver’s license must be verified by completing a motor vehicle record check at the time of hire

**Preferred**

* Associate degree, Bachelor’s degree
* Five or more years of experience leading a team, mentoring and coaching subordinates

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Results Oriented (Energetic self-starter; sets realistic goals; meets commitments; persistent, prioritizes daily to achieve results)

* Financial Acumen (understands profit drivers; utilizes metrics to manage; builds the financial understanding of staff and clinicians; understands local market drivers and competition

* Requires knowledge of Dental Plans,insurances fees, administrative guidelines, limitations and exclusions, reporting systems; business correspondence and business reporting techniques; and business principles of profit & loss statements
* Skills required include use of knowledge of all Microsoft Applications, Epic, 1VU, BOX, and use of standard office equipment

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook .

**About the Role:**

The Manager of Clinical Operations is responsible for the technical operations of the Clinical Laboratory. The Manager monitors patient and quality control testing results, writes and reviews standard operating procedures, addresses technical issues and takes remedial action when needed. The Manager ensures laboratory staff are correctly trained on all processes and supervises both licensed and unlicensed laboratory team members. As a leader of the Clinical Operations function as well, the Manager will be responsible for supervision of the laboratory staff. The Manager demonstrates good judgment, sound analysis and decision making, the ability to remain professional and composed under pressure and the ability to communicate effectively across levels and functions. The Manager will ensure that the Clinical Lab team adheres to CLIA and CAP standards. The Manager complies with all applicable local, state and federal laboratory requirements and operates under the direction of the Laboratory Director and Director of Clinical Operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Accurately monitor molecular testing
* Conduct and oversee daily quantitation and qualification assessment of molecular data generated during testing
* Lead a variety of other essential laboratory activities, including reagent qualification, inventory management, procedure writing, inspection preparation, assay validation and investigation
* Work with the Clinical Laboratory General Supervisor, Technical Supervisor and the Accessioning Supervisor on the laboratory’s quality control and quality assurance procedures, technical troubleshooting and improvement procedures, reagent manufacturing, and training and education programs
* Review and document routine preventive maintenance and independently identify and troubleshoot highly complex problems that adversely affect test performance
* Identify root cause and document all corrective actions taken with test systems
* Oversee training and competency of new and existing laboratory personnel
* Manage stability study, validation protocols, and other process improvement and new assay projects
* Participate in audits and inspections
* Perform biennial review of Standard Operating Procedures
* Participate in introduction of assay improvements, new assay configurations and validation
* Support the Clinical Operations team and be responsible for the daily operations of the laboratory including but not limited to scheduling, independently troubleshooting and resolving technical and non-technical high complexity problems
Report all concerns of test quality and/or safety to the Laboratory Director or Safety Officer.  

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Biomedical Laboratory Science, Clinical Science or related field
* At least eight years of Clinical Laboratory experience or equivalent high complexity and volume laboratory experience preferred
* At least two years of supervisory experience preferred
* Working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Working knowledge of FDA QSR and ISO 13485 requirements a plus
* Laboratory experience within the last year preferred
* Experience in molecular biology techniques preferred
* Strong working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Able to integrate and apply feedback in a professional manner
* Ability to manage daily test processing needs with high emphasis on quality
* Ability to analyze and problem solve basic issues that impact test performance
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Strong computer and automation skills
* Ability to proactively communicate consistently, clearly, and honestly
* Outstanding professionalism, leadership, and communications skills
* Strong communicator with ability to maintain open communication with internal employees, managers and customers as needed
* Ability to provide direct supervision to laboratory personnel
Strong project management abilities.  

  

**Work Environments:**

* Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs;
* Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary;
* May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high-speed centrifugation;
* May be required to lift routine office supplies and use office equipment;
* Majority of the work is performed in a desk/office environment; and
Ability to sit for extended periods of time.  

  

**AI & Digital Fluency**

Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

jobs.description:
**Discover your next career at** **Mygrant Glass****!**

**About Us:**

**Mygrant Glass** was established in 1926, we've journeyed from a single location in California to becoming the largest independent wholesale distributor of automotive glass in the United States. Our enduring success is built on a foundation of unparalleled inventory, an extensive warehouse network, and uncompromising quality standards. We thrive on forming lasting partnerships that drive the success of our valued customers.

**Why Join Mygrant Glass?**

We’re the largest independent auto glass distributor in the United States—but we operate with the values of a family-owned company. We value safety, teamwork, and providing opportunities for growth.

*We also value fair and competitive pay rates.*

Where a pay band is provided, actual pay may be **above** the listed range based on the individual's experience, education, certifications, knowledge, skills, and geography/work location. The listed range reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this opportunity at the time of posting.

Non-exempt employees will be paid overtime in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law. Base pay does not include other forms of compensation. Mygrant Glass is proud to offer its employees a comprehensive benefits package including:

* ***Medical***
* ***Dental***
* ***Vision***
* ***Life insurance***
* ***FSA plans***
* ***401(k) plus matching***
* ***Holiday, sick, and vacation days***

**Exempt**

**Reports To:** **Regional Operations Director**

**Senior Operations Manager**

**Branches: San Jose, Hayward, Oakland, Martinez, San Francisco**

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The Senior Operations Manager is tasked with managing several warehouses within an assigned region. In this role, they are pivotal in overseeing high-value inventory, ensuring exceptional customer service, and building high-performing teams. Their focus includes safety, branch operations, warehouse efficiency, and driving customer service excellence through key performance metrics.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Effectively communicate the “Mygrant Messages” to customers and employees across multiple branches.
* Monitor and uphold operations performance goals and standards, ensuring consistency across all branches.
* Partner and collaborate with internal departments to efficiently meet branch objectives and ensure adherence to company procedures and standards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and various regulations, including state and federal guidelines, safety protocols, and OSHA and DOT regulations.
* Design and implement processes that contribute to the profitable growth of each respective branch to achieve and surpass branch goals while meeting the annual budget.
* Monitor and coach optimal inventory practices to guarantee stock accuracy, maintain fill rates, and ensure prompt receiving.
* Develop comprehensive business plans tailored to the unique operations of each branch.
* Clearly define branch goals and disseminate them throughout the branch network.
* Oversee the overall security of branches and the well-being of branch employees.
* Responsible for safeguarding company assets, which includes ensuring branches are handling money in accordance with established controls and protocols. Identify and report any potential risk areas, providing valuable feedback to enhance security measures and protect assets effectively.
* Mentor and coach manager and supervisors to foster a culture of growth and development to facilitate a smooth branch succession plan and streamline operations.
* Implement performance management strategies including coaching branch teams toward achieving successful performance goals.
* Manage teams to provide outstanding customer service while also ensuring prompt collection of customer payments.
* Serve as a valuable resource to teams within designated branches to ensure support and collaboration while meeting KPI objectives.
* Travel to designated branches as required to evaluate branch operations, identify current needs, and implement necessary corrective actions to ensure continued progress.
* Collaborate with the territory account manager and/or sales team to achieve customer service objectives.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven leadership and ability to cultivate a culture of teamwork, customer focus, and respect.
* Live and work with a very high level of integrity.
* Keen eye for detail and safety.
* Demonstrate a track record of career growth in business management, retail and warehouse management experience preferred.
* Direct involvement in developing customer service experiences and exceeding expectations.
* High level of experience with Microsoft products.
* Experience with both fleet and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety and maintenance preferred.
* Solid interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.

**EDUCATION AND LICENSING:**

* High School Diploma, GED or equivalent required
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Valid Driver’s License required and pass MVR review under company guidelines.
* Maintain an MVR record that is insurable under company guidelines.
* CMV DOT Medical Card preferred.
* Pass and maintain Material Handling Equipment Certifications including Forklift certification, and other internal and external certifications.
* 5+ years of experience with inventory control, inventory reconciliation, and cycle counting.
* Proven track record of 4+ years in management of at least ten employees including recruiting, hiring, and developing top talent.

**BENEFITS:**

* Health Insurance
* Flexible Spending Plan
* Health Savings Plan
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Sick Time
* Paid Holidays
* 401K/with matching

You will be the primary point of contact for assigned customers, taking ownership of their requests and keeping work moving from initial inquiry through completion. This is a hands-on, office-based role in a busy service environment. You should be comfortable managing multiple accounts and active jobs, communicating directly with property managers, and holding technicians accountable for clear updates, complete documentation, and follow-through.

**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $75,000 - $108,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 1) is responsible for executing assigned manufacturing projects under the guidance of a Program Manager or senior Project Manager. This role takes the execution of defined project scopes, manages day-to-day coordination, tracks progress against schedules, and drives task completion across cross-functional teams. While guidance is provided, Level 1 Project Managers are expected to work independently on assigned responsibilities, proactively identify issues, and take initiative in following up on actions and deliverables.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage assigned manufacturing projects or project components, taking ownership of schedules, task tracking, and execution within defined scope. Ensure execution meets defined quality, quantity, and delivery commitments.

* Develop and maintain project timelines based on customer requirements, material readiness, and available production resources.

* Coordinate day-to-day activities with Engineering, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to ensure project progress aligns with plan.

* Actively monitor project status, identify risks or delays, and escalate issues with proposed options or recommendations when needed.

* Track production progress and resource availability, following up with responsible teams to close gaps.

* Conduct routine project meetings or working sessions as assigned; document action items and ensure timely follow-through.

* Prepare and deliver accurate project status updates and reports to Program Managers and internal stakeholders.

* Apply standard project management tools, templates, and processes to ensure consistency and transparency.

* Continuously build knowledge of manufacturing operations, workflows, and cross-functional dependencies to improve project execution.

  

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for assigned projects and deliverables.
* Ability to work independently while effectively leveraging guidance and feedback.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional coordination.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impact, and escalate with context.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in tracking schedules, data, and commitments.
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with changing priorities.
* Collaborative interpersonal skills to maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* Entry-level professional experience, internships, or academic project work related to project coordination, manufacturing, operations, or business support is beneficial.

**Position Summary**  
The Buck Institute’s Clinical Research Core is looking for an organized, motivated clinical research leader to run the in-person visits for THRIVE and serve as the operational heart of our on-site clinic.  
  
THRIVE is the clinical validation arm of PROSPR, an ARPA-H-funded program working to design the first FDA registration trial for a gerotherapeutic. THRIVE is developing the aging-relevant outcome measures such a trial would rely on, seeing how they perform with real participants, and testing them in a YMCA-guided lifestyle intervention.  
  
**Why join us**

* **Real ownership.** Clinical research is growing fast at the Buck, and our team is small. You’ll have high visibility and a direct hand in every stage of planning, conducting, and reporting research.
* **Variety.** Your time splits roughly evenly between leading THRIVE study visits and managing a clinic that runs 6–10 diverse studies on-site.
* **Great colleagues.** You’ll work alongside our Clinical Research Co-Directors (Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, a clinical research scientist with more than a decade of experience) and an experienced Clinical Operations Manager.
* **A mission that matters.** Your work helps lay the groundwork for testing interventions that could extend healthy years of life.

**Key Responsibilities**  
*THRIVE Study Leadership (~50%)*

* Lead day-to-day execution of THRIVE in line with the protocol, GCP, ICH guidelines, and Buck Clinical Research SOPs.
* Translate the protocol into participant flow and scheduling across the clinic and community sites, adapting quickly when one change affects staff, rooms, and equipment at once.
* Lead a team of two senior and two junior research associates who collect data at community locations 2-3 days per week.

One of the following in clinical research or project management in a biomedical or clinical research setting:

* High school diploma/technical degree and 8+ years of experience
* Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience i
* Master's or PhD degree and 2+ years of experience

**Skills**

* Clinical skills/background sufficient to train, mentor, and oversee quality for study staff performing clinical procedures
* Supervisory or team leadership experience
* Experience preparing or submitting IRB protocols, amendments, or continuing reviews
* Strong organization across concurrent studies and priorities, with reliable follow-through, initiative, and proactive problem-solving
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication; comfortable working independently, as part of a team, and with all levels of management
* Attention to deadlines and budgetary guidelines

**Nice to have**

* Professional certification such as PMP, ACRP-CP, SOCRA CCRP, or equivalent
* Experience with project management software (e.g., Wrike, MS Project) and EDC systems (e.g., REDCap)
* Phlebotomy certification/experience
* Clinical research experience in a non-profit/academic setting

**Compensation & Job Details**

* Full-time, 40 hours per week, onsite. You’ll be available in person or on call during clinic visit hours (7:30 am – 2:00 pm)
* Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 / year commensurate with experience
* Benefits include health insurance, paid parental leave, PTO, and a 401(k) with 5% employer match

**JOB** **TITLE****:** Project Manager 2  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $78,000 - $110,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 2) manages manufacturing projects of moderate complexity, taking ownership of project execution. This role operates with minimal supervision, drives cross-functional coordination, and ensures project commitments related to quality, schedule, and delivery are met. In addition to executing assigned projects, Level 2 Project Managers provide guidance and day-to-day coaching to entry-level Project Managers and Project Coordinators, helping build team capability and execution consistency.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage one or more manufacturing projects independently, owning schedules, execution plans, and day-to-day coordination.

* Review material readiness, production output, and logistics status; coordinate adjustments as needed to maintain delivery commitments.

* Develop detailed project timelines based on customer requirements, material availability, and production capacity.

* Coordinate proactively with Engineering, Process Engineering, Quality, Test, Production, Supply Chain, and other teams to ensure alignment and execution.

* Monitor project progress against plan, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.

* Lead routine project meetings, drive action-item closure, and ensure accountability across stakeholders.

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, ensuring timely and accurate communication with internal stakeholders.

* Support projects as assigned, adapting execution approach based on project phase and complexity.

* Prepare and present clear, data-driven project status reports, risk assessments, and recovery plans to Program Managers.

* Mentor and coach Level 1 Project Managers and Project Coordinators by reviewing work, sharing best practices, and providing execution guidance.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of project management processes, templates, and execution standards

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Proven ability to manage manufacturing projects independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to make sound judgments and recommendations.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills across cross-functional and multi-level stakeholders.
* Ability to identify risks early, prioritize issues, and drive resolution in dynamic environments.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects concurrently.
* Analytical problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess trade-offs and impacts.
* Coaching and mentoring skills to support the development of junior team members.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with evolving priorities.

  

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in project management, manufacturing operations, supply chain, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects with increasing scope and complexity.

The Services Program Manager works under limited supervision and direction, regularly exercising discretionary and substantial decision-making authority in a heavily matrixed organization, coordinating cross-functional and offshore teams with the expectation to move quickly, stay organized and remain effective under ambiguity. jobs.title: Care Coordinator - Home Care
jobs.description:
**Care Coordinator - Home Care** (Concord / East Bay)

**Schedule**: Full-time, primarily Monday–Friday

**Work Arrangement**: Approximately 80% field-based, 20% office-based

**Reports To**: Operations Manager

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The ECC is primarily a field-based position responsible for bringing on new clients, managing ongoing client relationships, overseeing care quality, supervising caregivers in the field, and developing referral relationships.

The ECC is accountable for new client acquisition, client retention and satisfaction, referral growth, and care quality. The position carries independent decision-making authority within established company parameters to achieve these outcomes.

We're looking for someone with a strong hands-on caregiving background who can confidently assess client needs and caregiver competencies. Sales experience isn't required, as we'll provide training in that area.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Client Consultations & Relationship Management

* Independently conduct in-home consultations with prospective clients and families, assess care needs, recommend appropriate services, and work toward converting consultations into new clients.
* Negotiate client rates and adjust or waive hourly minimums within established company parameters to help close sales.
* Develop and update individualized care plans in coordination with Operations.
* Manage ongoing relationships with an assigned book of clients after services begin, including quality assurance and reassessments at least every 90 days, or more frequently at the ECC's discretion.
* Independently evaluate changes in client needs, determine appropriate service recommendations, and coordinate implementation with Operations.
* Address client concerns, determine appropriate next steps, and work with Operations to support client satisfaction and retention.

2. Field Quality Assurance & Caregiver Supervision

* Serve as one of the caregivers' supervisors, with responsibility for overseeing caregiver performance and care quality during field visits.
* Conduct in-home quality assurance visits to evaluate caregiver performance, service delivery, and client satisfaction.
* Exercise authority to coach caregivers, address performance concerns, and remove caregivers from client assignments when appropriate.
* Make recommendations regarding caregiver discipline, promotion, and termination that carry significant weight and are ordinarily acted upon by management, subject to applicable company procedures.
* Lead the hands-on caregiver skills portion of new-hire orientation weekly, including evaluating competencies and exercising authority to dismiss caregivers from orientation for performance or conduct concerns.

The ECC works closely with the Operations Manager and scheduling team but exercises independent supervisory judgment and authority within their areas of responsibility.

**3. Sales & Business Development**

* Independently identify, develop, and manage relationships with referral sources, including hospitals, rehabilitation facilities, senior living communities, and other healthcare professionals.
* Determine which referral opportunities to pursue and independently schedule and conduct sales calls, referral-source visits, presentations, and community outreach.
* Maintain ownership of referral relationships, including ongoing follow-up and development of new business opportunities.
* Manage prospective client opportunities through consultation, follow-up, negotiation, and conversion.
* Be accountable for measurable goals related to referral development, qualified opportunities, consultation conversions, new client starts, and business growth.

**WORK STRUCTURE & INDEPENDENT DECISION-MAKING**

We anticipate the ECC spending approximately 80% of their working time in the field, with the remaining 20% dedicated to documentation, follow-up, internal meetings, and coordination with Operations.

* The ECC independently determines, schedules, and prioritizes their field activities based on client needs, business opportunities, and operational priorities. This includes:
* Scheduling prospective client consultations, coordinating with clients and families as necessary.
* Scheduling routine client reassessments and independently determining when additional visits are warranted.
* Identifying and scheduling quality assurance visits based on client needs and service quality concerns.
* Scheduling sales calls and meetings with referral sources, including determining which relationships and opportunities to prioritize.
* Adjusting field priorities and appointments as circumstances change, without requiring day-to-day direction from the Operations Manager.

The ECC is responsible for managing competing priorities and determining how best to allocate their field time to achieve established performance objectives.

In addition to managing their own schedule, the ECC exercises independent judgment regarding client care recommendations, service arrangements, pricing within company parameters, referral development, and caregiver performance matters.

Although the position reports to the Operations Manager, the ECC is expected to independently manage their assigned responsibilities and is held accountable for the resulting business and client outcomes.

**PERFORMANCE ACCOUNTABILITY**

The ECC's performance will be evaluated based on results across four primary areas:

* New Client Acquisition: Consultation conversion rates, new client starts, and business generated.
* Client Retention & Satisfaction: Client relationships, retention, responsiveness to changing needs, and resolution of service concerns.
* Referral Growth: Development of productive referral relationships and generation of qualified new business opportunities.
* Care Quality: Quality of services delivered to assigned clients, caregiver performance, and effective resolution of concerns identified during field visits.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base salary**: $70,500 –

jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivaled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. Our work provides leadership, know-how, and partnering on quality across Molecules (GCP), Products (Drug and/or Medical Devices), Pharma affiliates, and global regulated processes.

This role supports the Roche/Genentech Organization by developing and delivering Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post approval products, affiliates and processes, based on a risk-based approach. Quality Assurance strategies are based on the Critical to Quality framework, encompassing Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), Medical Device, and Computer Systems (CS) requirements.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Lead to join the Quality Assurance Programs team. You will bring diverse thinking and technical experience in various Quality disciplines (e.g., GCP, CSV, device).

**Note: This role requires strong level GCP knowledge and will be accountable for the quality assurance aspects and leading/supporting inspections of key molecules. CSV and device are preferred but not the main requirement.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

The **Senior Quality Lead** is a highly experienced Quality Professional who:

* **Designs and delivers Quality Strategies and conclusions** for assigned Molecules by applying a risk-based approach based on the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. Establish strong partnerships with business stakeholders and independently define the Quality Assurance approach, assessing specific risk areas and proposing strategy modifications.
* **Define and Lead Audits:** Define the audits required to deliver the Quality Assurance strategy and lead the development of methodology, including the use of data analytics.Independently perform and lead audits, managing preparation, conduct, presentation, timely reporting of outcomes, and evaluation of actions taken.
* **Issue Management:** Independently manage complex quality issues, group individual findings into systematic issues for process improvement, and escalate significant issues to PDQ management.
* **Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication:** Independently draw conclusions on the Quality Positions and ensure appropriate action plans are developed to determine acceptability of evidence of compliance. Lead the presentation of observations and associated compliance risks to business stakeholders and Pharma representatives, including discussions with Legal and Regulatory Affairs.
* **PDQ Goals and Initiatives:** Contribute and participate in PDQ goals and initiatives to the execution and delivery of PDQ work and the development of PDQ processes.
* **Health Authority Inspections:**Lead and support regulatory authority inspections.
* Mentor and support the development of Quality Leads within the team.

* **PDQ Leadership:** Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead departmental or cross-functional compliance projects, and lead the development/revision of PDQ processes and procedures (SOPs, Work Instructions).
* **Expertise and Mentorship:** Maintain expert knowledge of GCP/GVP regulations, company policies, and SOPs, assess the impact of new regulations, and act as a trainer and mentor for International and Senior Quality Leads.
* **Networking:** Maintain and influence partnerships with senior business stakeholders and PDQ domains. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality standards are met globally.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Professional and Technical Requirements:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in scientific or quality-related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* Demonstrated applied knowledge of clinical / pharmacovigilance / drug safety and regulatory requirements.
* Project management experience with proven leadership, mentoring and coaching; Demonstrated ability to effectively organize and execute tasks
* High degree of experience, competency, and proven track record leading multiple complex audit types in multiple GCP areas.

**Preferred**

* Device / CSV experience
* Strong digital and data literacy
* Experience hosting, managing and/or supporting regulatory authority inspections; Ability to formulate clear business questions that can be answered with data and utilize data/visualization tools to generate insights.
* Proven ability to influence and negotiate effective solutions, drive change, and assimilate new compliance information/trends.
* Proven record of working in a global, multicultural matrixed organization (multi-lingual skills desirable).

This role is based at our South San Francisco, CA campus. (Onsite presence is preferred, however, a remote option is a possibility.)

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $141,000 - $261,800. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at link provided below.

Benefits

Genentech is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination

jobs.title: Supplier Sourcing Program Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Sourcing Analyst – External Manufacturing at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) will play a pivotal role in expanding and scaling our next-generation cloud services. As a member of the Global Strategic Sourcing Group, you will make strategic decisions that impact supplier cost, technical capabilities, and supply availability, ensuring the delivery of critical hardware to our customers. The Strategic Sourcing Analyst supports the External Manufacturing (EM) Sourcing team by providing tactical coordination of supply, sourcing analysis, cost modeling, supplier management, process improvement, Blanket Purchase Order (BPO) execution, risk-buy purchases, and supplier/product qualification activities. The role is critical to maintaining continuity of supply and ensuring timely execution of sourcing activities with Oracle’s contract manufacturing partners supporting Cloud Infrastructure.

  

* Support sourcing strategies for external manufacturing partners (contract manufacturers), and related suppliers.
* Analyze supplier spend, pricing, cost structures, capacity, lead times, and other commercial and operational data to identify sourcing opportunities and risks.
* Support supplier selection activities, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, bid analysis, supplier evaluations, and sourcing recommendations.
* Develop cost models and conduct pricing analyses to establish negotiation targets and identify cost-reduction opportunities.
* Participate in supplier commercial negotiations covering pricing, capacity, lead times, payment terms, liability, and other business requirements.
* Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Quality, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into sourcing strategies and supplier actions.
* Monitor supplier performance and identify risks related to cost, capacity, continuity of supply, quality, delivery, and manufacturing execution.
* Support business reviews with external manufacturing partners by developing performance metrics, analyses, presentations, and action plans.
* Identify and execute cost optimization, productivity, and value-improvement initiatives while maintaining supply, quality, and business requirements.
* Support new product introductions, product transitions, manufacturing changes, and other sourcing activities throughout the product lifecycle.
* Maintain sourcing data, supplier information, commercial documentation, and reporting required for effective category and supplier management.
* Develop dashboards and analyses that provide visibility into sourcing performance, supplier trends, cost opportunities, and business risks.
* Drive assigned sourcing projects from analysis through recommendation, stakeholder alignment, and implementation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of sourcing processes, analytical tools, reporting, and supplier-management practices.

jobs.title: KYC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to support the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance programs within Meta's financial services and payments ecosystem. In this role, you will help ensure that Meta's customer due diligence, identity verification, and onboarding controls meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal policy standards. You will partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Engineering, Product, and Operations to identify compliance gaps, drive program improvements, and scale KYC processes as Meta's payments and financial products grow. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a compliance function that directly supports the integrity and trustworthiness of Meta's financial services offerings.  
  
  

### **KYC Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support the execution of KYC program initiatives, including customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and identity verification workflows across Meta's payments and financial services products
* Monitor KYC program health by tracking key performance indicators, identifying control gaps, and escalating risks or issues to appropriate stakeholders
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Operations teams to design and implement scalable KYC controls and onboarding processes that meet regulatory requirements
* Translate regulatory requirements and internal policy standards into clear operational procedures and technical specifications for cross-functional partners
* Drive process improvements and operational enhancements that increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of KYC workflows
* Develop and maintain program documentation including policies, procedures, process maps, and control inventories relevant to KYC and customer due diligence obligations
* Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and compliance reviews by preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and tracking remediation efforts
* Collaborate with data and analytics partners to build reporting and monitoring capabilities that provide visibility into KYC program performance and risk exposure
* Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across compliance, legal, and business functions, including periodic updates to leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in compliance program management, regulatory operations, or a related function within financial services, fintech, or a technology company with payment or financial products
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to drive work to completion with limited oversight
* Experience translating regulatory or policy requirements into operational procedures, controls, or technical specifications
* Experience with KYC, customer onboarding, due diligence, identity verification, risk, or compliance frameworks and their operational implementation
* Experience designing and operating model monitoring, testing, or attestation frameworks and producing audit- or regulator-ready evidence
* Proficiency in data analysis and techniques (SQL) to perform root cause analysis and inform process-based redesign

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience developing and implementing automation (e.g., performing prompt engineering, benchmarking, launch planning) in a business context
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with BSA/AML regulatory requirements, FinCEN guidance, or international KYC standards applicable to payments or financial services products
* Experience using data analysis or reporting tools to monitor compliance program metrics and surface actionable insights for program improvement
* Experience working with automated identity verification platforms, onboarding tooling, or KYC technology solutions in a fintech or payments environment

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Social Science Matrix (4800C) #89496
jobs.description:
Program Manager, Social Science Matrix (4800C) #89496 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Social Science Matrix is UC Berkeley's flagship institute for social science research. We provide an organizational framework to support the cross-disciplinary research pursued by more than 500 social scientists across the Berkeley campus research landscape and beyond. Matrix provides an intellectual hub for faculty, graduate students, and colleagues to collaborate as we bring the unique tools of the social sciences to bear on the urgent matters of this moment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager works closely with the Director to help develop and implement an intellectual vision and programming calendar for Matrix; to identify and pursue collaborative initiatives; and to identify and pursue fundraising strategies. This position involves a blend of program administration, event management, outreach, and development activities to support the diverse needs of the academic community served by the Matrix, which consists of faculty and graduate students across the social sciences. Ideally, the Program Manager will have a background or an advanced degree in the social sciences, substantial experience in writing/editing, and be a thought partner to help the Director identify promising topics and speakers.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Administration & Management
  
  
Collaborates with the faculty Director to conceptualize, develop, and monitor programs and activities across Matrix's research portfolio, ensuring alignment with the institution's strategic goals.
  
Coordinates the call for applications and reviewers for Matrix programs, managing timelines, communications, and selection processes.
  
Prepares detailed agendas and comprehensive reports for advisory board meetings, ensuring all necessary documentation and materials are available.
  
Serves as primary administrative contact and point of support for the Director; efficiently funnels inquiries and time-sensitive items to appropriate personnel.
  
Meets regularly with faculty fellows and occasionally attends research teams' meetings to stay informed about ongoing projects and provide administrative support.
  
Meets frequently with Matrix fellows and grant recipients to support their research and organize their events, offering guidance on logistics and planning.
  
Participates in planning, organizing, and staffing program events of varied scope and complexity, some of which will occasionally take place during early evening or weekend hours.
  
Develops and implements event budgets, monitors expenditures, and determines event staffing needs to ensure fiscal responsibility and adequate support.
  
Coordinates and assists with event catering, AV services, and guest travel, accommodation, and reimbursement in collaboration with the events assistant.
  
Researches and resolves vendor issues, processes invoices, and ensures timely payment for services rendered.
  
  
Outreach and Engagement
  
  
Collaborates with the Communications Director on the style, content, and functionality of Matrix media, including website, newsletter, and marketing, with the goal of promoting the mission and activities of Matrix.
  
Produces content for reports, website, and media, highlighting the achievements and activities of Matrix programs.
  
Works with the Faculty Director to research topics and guests, and develop interview questions for Matrix podcasts, ensuring content aligns with the institution's academic standards.
  
Conducts interviews for Matrix podcasts and audits transcripts for accuracy, ensuring high-quality and professional presentations.
  
Oversees outreach to constituencies on campus to cultivate their participation in Matrix, fostering a sense of community and engagement.
  
Promotes Matrix services for joint programming, center or research support, encouraging collaboration and interdisciplinary initiatives.
  
  
Space Management
  
  
Maintains the physical space and enclosed event spaces, ensuring they are clean, organized, and ready for use.
  
Serves as the point of contact for event space use for Matrix partners and acts as a liaison to groups utilizing the space.
  
Communicates policies regarding the use of Matrix space to visitors and occasional users.
  
Provides technical support for installed AV systems and sets up spaces for both Matrix and non-Matrix events.
  
Manages scheduling and booking of event spaces, ensuring efficient use of facilities and preventing scheduling conflicts.
  
Develops and implements procedures for supply inventory and to keep equipment in good working condition.

jobs.title: Customer Success & Deployment Leader
jobs.description:
### **About Noble Machines**

Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

### **Position Overview**

We're looking for an exceptional Customer Success & Deployment Leader to build and lead the organization that takes Noble Machines' general-purpose robots from signed contract to dependable, everyday operation at customer sites. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you'll own customer outcomes from the first pilot through fleet scale-up, renewal, and expansion, and you'll be the bridge between our customers and Noble Machines' engineering, autonomy, product, and service teams. You'll make sure our robots show up ready for the realities of construction, mining, and energy sites - and that they keep delivering value long after they arrive.

### **Responsibilities**

* Build the organization. Build and lead a team of deployment program managers, field and application engineers, and customer success managers, scaling the team and its leadership as Noble Machines grows.
* Own deployments end-to-end. Take full ownership from site assessment and task scoping through validation in Sunnyvale, on-site integration, commissioning, and hand-off to steady-state operations.
* Set deployment readiness standards. Define the safety, reliability, uptime, and performance criteria a robot must meet before it goes to a customer site—including readiness for dust, vibration, temperature extremes, and the unpredictable conditions of heavy-industry work.
* Run a repeatable playbook. Standardize how Noble Machines deploys: pilot-to-production gates, simulation and test validation, integration with customer site operations and safety programs, and change management and training for frontline crews working alongside our robots.
* Deliver and prove value. Track and report robot uptime, task throughput, time-to-productivity, intervention rate, hazardous-exposure hours removed from workers, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention.
* Close the loop with engineering. Channel field data, failure modes, and customer requirements back to Noble Machines' engineering and product teams to shape the roadmap and improve reliability in the field.
* Manage executive relationships. Serve as the senior point of contact for customers' operations, safety, and site leadership; lead executive business reviews and own escalations.
* Work with partners. Coordinate with contractors, site operators, integrators, and service partners to keep deployments on schedule and on spec.

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years in customer success, professional services, field engineering, or deployment leadership, with at least 5 years in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or complex hardware-plus-software products.
* Proven experience moving robotic or autonomous hardware out of R&D and into commercial production at external customer sites.
* Experience building and leading distributed, field-based teams.
* Working knowledge of robot autonomy, simulation and sim-to-real validation, and industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ANSI/A3 R15.06).
* Strong commercial sense, including renewals, expansion, services pricing, and deployment P&L.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior customer leaders, from site superintendents to the C-suite.
* Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, including active construction, mining, and energy job sites.

### **Nice to Have**

* Direct experience deploying robots or autonomous equipment in construction, mining, energy, or other heavy-industry environments.
* Background in engineering or computer science; an MBA is a plus.
* Familiarity with jobsite safety programs and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
* Experience scaling a customer-facing organization at an early-stage hardware company.

### **California Pay Transparency Statement**

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. jobs.description:
**Account Manager/Technical Manager**
=====================================

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager/Technical Manager (7987)**

**Overview of Role**

The Account Manager serves as a primary commercial and operational interface between TSMC North America and its advanced-node and 3DIC customers, managing the business relationship across quotation and pricing, demand forecasting and fulfillment, new tape-out management, and technology-roadmap engagement. Based within the North America Account Management organization and reporting to the Account Management Director, this role coordinates closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan and with internal operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) teams to ensure seamless execution and customer satisfaction. It is a hands-on role at the outset that grows into broader account ownership and new-business enablement, offering a seasoned semiconductor professional the opportunity to shape how TSMC supports its most advanced technology customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the end-to-end business relationship for assigned accounts, leading pricing and quotation discussions and ensuring there is no disconnect between the customer and TSMC.
* Own demand forecasting and fulfillment, aligning internal forecast and program execution across operations and planning to close the loop and complete the business.
* Drive new tape-out management — planning, execution, and operational coordination with headquarters customer service for new product introductions on advanced nodes.
* Promote TSMC's technology roadmap to customers and coordinate internal resources across operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) to meet and exceed customer requirements.
* Resolve production and supply issues across the factory, headquarters, and customer, and grow into account strategy and new-business enablement over time.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, a related engineering/science discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 12 or more years of relevant semiconductor industry experience in account management, business development, technical program management, or applications/field engineering.
* Demonstrated program or project management experience and prior team-lead experience with strong cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong semiconductor domain knowledge, with the ability to discuss process technology and packaging technology credibly with customers at engineering, program management, and executive levels.
* Financial and commercial acumen, with availability to coordinate regularly with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan during evening hours (approximately four to five nights per week).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's or PhD in a relevant engineering or science discipline.
* Direct experience with 3DIC and 3nm-and-below technologies.
* Hands-on integrated circuit (IC) or process-integration background complementing customer-facing experience.
* Experience spanning quotation, demand forecasting, new tape-out management, and technology-roadmap promotion within a foundry, fabless, or semiconductor supplier environment.
* Background gained at a leading semiconductor customer, competitor, or supplier organization.

**What Success Looks Like**

90 days: Hands-on and contributing on task-level account and operational work.

6 months: Developing and extending existing account work in a more business-oriented direction.

1 year: Operating as a full Account Manager — supporting customers directly and enabling new business.

**Company Description**

As a trusted technology and capacity provider, TSMC is driven by the desire to be:

* The world's leading dedicated semiconductor foundry
* The technology leader with a strong reputation for manufacturing excellence

TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world's leading dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. The Company supports a thriving ecosystem of global customers and partners with the industry's leading process technologies and a portfolio of design enablement solutions to unleash innovation for the global semiconductor industry. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

jobs.title: Case Manager, SUD and Peer Counselor, San Mateo
jobs.description:
The Care Coordinator/Case Manager is responsible for developing and providing high quality therapeutic interventions and services in support of an individual’s wellness and recovery. Services include strength-based and needs-based therapeutic case management, problem-solving, therapeutic rehabilitation including skills-building, benefits support, resource development, housing navigation, crisis intervention, and family support.

ACT (Assertive Community Treatment) team provides direct service to acute mental health crisis cases in our new Full Service Partnership (FSP) Program in San Mateo. BACS’ staff does whatever it takes to find permanent housing for homeless people or stabilize mental health cases and the work happens both in the office, or out in the community.

This program will have specialty populations including CARE Court and Substance Use Disorder (SUD) focus. Care Act is a statewide initiative to allow family members and other community members to request San Mateo County to assess and support partners who may have slipped through the cracks of our system and would benefit from linkage to services. The FSP programming itself offers a multidisciplinary approach and ACT model to offer 7-day support to partners experiencing the highest level of need in our county and would benefit from a hospital without walls wraparound approach.

This is a community-based position providing direct, face-to-face services to individuals who are chronically homeless, travel throughout San Mateo County is required, as is transporting clients in your personal vehicle.

**Schedules: Sun -Thurs, Tues -Saturday**

### **Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for development and delivery of a full complement of services, including individual, family, group counseling, individual rehabilitation and case management/brokerage for individuals within the Care Coordinator's caseload as assigned.
* Responsible for utilizing Evidence Based Practice for the designated population/program to assure high quality results and intended impact.
* Responsible for continuously assessing individual’s risk status including risk based on symptoms, substance use, environment, physical conditions, etc and intervening appropriately.
* Responsible for assessing the continued service necessity and creating a service plan that aims at an individual getting better/healthy and accomplishing service goals that are person-centered and belong to the client.
* Responsible for continuous outreach and progressive engagement and reporting disengagement to the team immediately. Responsible for working with outreach team and determining when to disenroll individual based on program protocols.
* Responsible for domain-based assessment, screening referrals, service planning, community planning and benefit coordination which supports wellness and recovery principles. Responsible for care planning and therapeutic case management using a whatever it takes approach.
* Documents and maintains all data collection, reporting, and charting records in accordance with BACS and other relevant county regulatory policies/agencies. Responsible for producing required number of regulatory units of service per month (65% of staff’s time must be providing face-to-face or other eligible community-based support).
* Participates in supervision, staff meetings, consultation, travel, crisis/emergency coverage, weekend coverage, as well as, agency-wide meetings and training, as required by manager.
* Able to work independently and as a member of a therapeutic team.
* Is adaptable and open to change and new information; adapts behavior and work methods in response to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles. Adjusts rapidly to new situations warranting attention and resolution.
* Is effective at balancing interests of a variety of clients; readily readjusts priorities to respond to pressing and changing client demands. Anticipates and meets the need of clients; achieves quality end-products; is committed to continuous improvement of services.

**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma required and must have 4 years of paid work experience in mental health/social services. One of those years may be in a customer service function. Degree is preferred.
* Valid California driver’s license, personal vehicle, and proof of personal vehicle insurance coverage are required. DMV printout required.
* Extensive local travel is required, vehicle reimbursement is provided. Care Coordinators transport clients in their personal vehicle.

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery across Netflix's world-class content ecosystem - balancing member experience with strong outcomes for advertisers. As one of the newest entrants in the fast-growing Connected TV advertising space, we're building the identity and audience infrastructure that differentiates Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end lifecycle of the audience identifiers that power targeting, optimization, and measurement across Netflix Ads. You'll define and drive the roadmap for our identity management platform, spanning the identity graph, public APIs, direct advertiser integrations, partner ingestion, and unified identifier storage, and set the strategic direction for how Netflix builds a durable, privacy-forward identity foundation in a rapidly evolving ad tech landscape. Key Responsibilities include:

* Own product strategy and roadmap. Set the long-term vision for a unified identity platform that supports large-scale data ingestion, normalization, and retention, while balancing it against near-term delivery commitments.

* Drive cross-functional alignment. Work across sales, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, and legal to bring products to market and drive adoption at scale.
